notes: docs/theory/paper_b_prior_art_and_names.md. Length of the Collatz dropping time patterns in A186008, contributed 9 February 2011. Its own comment says 'This is A100982 with 1 prepended', and that prepended form is precisely what this laboratory computes: the NONZERO minimal-certificate counts M_d taken in order, skipping the free lengths. Verified here term by term against our counts: 1, 1, 1, 2, 3, 7, 12, 30, 85, 173, 476, 961. So the sequence this cluster produces by dropping the zeros from M_d already has a name, distinct from A100982, and the laboratory had cited A100982 alone. Found by the 2026-09-20 OEIS sweep.
